title: Nevus and melanoma in a single slide of patient A2 and A17
extract_protocol_ch1.1: The sequencing libraries were further prepared as per manufacturer’s instructions (document number CG000495 Rev C, 10X Genomics). In short, this included destaining, decrosslinking, probe hybridization, probe ligation, probe release, probe extension, and library construction.
data_processing: Raw sequencing data was processed using 10x SpaceRanger (v2.1.1) based on a probe set provided by the manufacturer (GRCh38-2020-A), a Visium CytAssist image and a H&E image of the slide. Data was further processed with the R-package semla. Spots with more than 500 genes were retained as well as spots with less than 30% mitochondrial counts.

data_processing.3: Supplementary files format and content: features.tsv.gz = list of gene Ids

data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: matrix.mtx.gz = gene expression count data
data_processing.6: Supplementary files format and content: scalefactors_json.json = scale factors in json format
data_processing.7: Supplementary files format and content: tissue_hires_image.png = high res image of the tissue
data_processing.8: Supplementary files format and content: tissue_lowres_image.png = low res image of the tissue
data_processing.9: Supplementary files format and content: tissue_positions.csv = list of spatial coordinates
